title: mhr_numerics: Numerical Mathematics Library for Arithmetic Spectroscopy
description: Reproducible software artefact accompanying the manuscript 'Spectral gap and modular degree of elliptic curves. Part I: Foundations of arithmetic spectroscopy' (A. Timakov, 2026). Provides: (1) exact linear algebra over finite prime fields F_p and GF(2); (2) classical lattice reduction algorithms (Gaussian 2D, LLL, BKZ, Babai CVP); (3) Lagrange polynomial interpolation and Berlekamp-Massey LFSR synthesis over F_p; (4) the MHR variational solver implementing the Gaussian ansatz energy functional for the Modular Hamiltonian Relaxation operator, minimised via L-BFGS-B with adiabatic coupling schedule.
